guards.title: Escape inside the open access menu closes only the menu
guards.goal: The first Escape closes the menu and keeps the dialog open

plan.root_cause: The Escape key pressed on the access toggle button is intercepted by the dropdown's data-api keydown handler, which prevents event propagation and stops the modal from receiving the Escape key to close.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the dropdown's dataApiKeydownHandler to only handle the Escape key when the dropdown is open (isActive), allowing Escape to bubble up to the modal when the dropdown is closed.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Escape key will now close the share modal when focus is on the access button, providing a keyboard mechanism to dismiss the dialog as required.
functional_risks: Escape will no longer close the dropdown when it is closed (which is correct behavior per BS5).
If any custom code relies on Escape being captured by the dropdown regardless of its open state, that behavior will change.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Escape when the dropdown is open still closes the dropdown.
Verify that pressing Escape when the dropdown is closed closes the share modal.
Verify that ArrowUp, ArrowDown, and Space keys continue to operate correctly for dropdown interaction.
Ensure no regression in other dropdown-related keyboard interactions.

plan.root_cause: The dropdown's dataApiKeydownHandler intercepts the Escape key even when the dropdown is closed, calling preventDefault() and stopPropagation() which prevents the event from bubbling to the modal's Escape handler. The previous fix only guarded the Escape handling block but left the preventDefault/stopPropagation calls before that block.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the dropdown's dataApiKeydownHandler to compute the dropdown's open state (isActive) early, and return without preventing default when Escape is pressed and the dropdown is closed. This allows the Escape event to propagate to the modal. For all other dropdown commands (including Escape when open), preventDefault and stopPropagation are still called.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Escape while focus is on the access toggle button will now close the share modal when the dropdown is closed, providing a keyboard mechanism to dismiss the dialog as required by WCAG 2.1.1 and 2.4.3. When the dropdown is open, Escape will still close the dropdown only.
functional_risks: Escape will no longer be intercepted by the dropdown when it is closed, which is the intended behavior.
If any custom code relies on Escape being captured by the dropdown regardless of its open state, that behavior will change.
ArrowUp, ArrowDown, and Space keys continue to operate correctly for dropdown interaction.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Escape when the dropdown is open still closes the dropdown.
Verify that pressing Escape when the dropdown is closed closes the share modal.
Verify that ArrowUp, ArrowDown, and Space keys continue to operate correctly for dropdown interaction.
Ensure no regression in other dropdown-related keyboard interactions.
